description: This file defines an Android activity (OverlayWindowActivity) that demonstrates how to display and manage overlay windows using the WindowManager. It handles permission requests, overlay display, and removal, and includes UI elements for user interaction.

classes.name: OverlayWindowActivity
classes.description: Main activity for managing overlay windows, including permissions and display logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, inflates layout, sets button click listeners.

methods.name: mShowOverlayListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that checks overlay permission and calls drawOverlay if granted or redirects to settings.

methods.name: mHideOverlayListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that removes the overlay view if present.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result after permission request to draw overlays, and if granted, calls drawOverlay.

methods.name: drawOverlay
methods.description: Creates and displays a simple overlay view on the screen.
